policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: Where two colors are still needed, take the one with the larger remaining count (ties: either).
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: Where two colors are still needed, choose the color this way: if `placed` is non-empty and its last entry is a color that still has fewer entries in `placed` than the goal requires, pick that same color again (a color once started is finished before any other color is touched); only when the last-placed color is complete move to another needed color. If `placed` is empty, any needed color may be started; as the fixed default, start the needed color with the larger required count, ties to the color named first in the goal instruction.

policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: Prefer a cube of that color that was already visible at the same place in the earlier execution steps of this decision step (or, at step #1, simply any cube of that color), and avoid detections that flicker in and out or that lie on top of the bin's position;
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: Among the cubes of that color, first discard any detection lying on top of the bin's position and prefer a detection present at the same place in every execution step of this decision step over one that appeared, vanished or moved mid-step (at step #1 all visible cubes of that color are candidates); if several candidates remain, take the one with the largest y, and on equal y the smallest x. A point offset by a pixel or two from the detection center is acceptable;

edits.modify_to: When the carried-in memory is blank (the first decision step), write placed=[] explicitly: the field is always output as an explicit list, even when empty.
